svg.title: Residual map
svg.desc: A scatter plot of the points of one synthetic cell, with theta in radians from -3.14 to 3.14 across and z in millimeters from 0 to 70 up. Most points are small and gray. They fill two bands, theta from about -3 to -0.1 and from about 0.1 to 3; near theta 0 (tag 4) and near plus or minus 3.14 there are almost no points. Tag 1 marks a small cluster of blue points at theta -1.0, z 18 mm (the dent). Tag 2 marks a tall, narrow blue cluster at theta 1.3, z 24 to 52 mm (the scratch). Tag 3 marks a small cluster of red points at theta -2.3, z 50 mm (the bulge).
